title: La Mora - sung repeat, lower piano staff
source_location: York University John Arpin collection JAC009399. Printed and PDF p. 4 system 5 after the repeat sign, system 6, and p. 5 system 1.
scope: Ten common 2/4 bars played twice, first and second endings in order. The previous one-bar text pickup belongs to the separate interlude excerpt.
editorial: The lower staff's three eighth notes under the triplet bracket on p. 4 system 6 take eight ticks each.
Short beam stubs in the five-note bass cells on pp. 4–5 are sixteenth-note flags. The other attacks in those cells are eighth notes.
The final C2 and C3 begin together at the last eighth of the second ending. Their ties continue into the untranscribed next bar, so the MIDI ends them at the excerpt boundary.
The MIDI uses the lower staff only, at an editorial quarter-note tempo of 96 and fixed velocity. The optional upper melody is in la-mora-grenet-sung-guide.json.
